description: Department of Local Government - Western Province - Appointed R. M. S. Pemalal Pinto as Chairman of the Seethawakapura Urban Council from 08.02.2023
categorisation: The gazette content specifically concerns the reappointment of a Chairman for a local government authority (Seethawakapura Urban Council) under the provisions of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls directly under electoral processes and appointments related to local government elections, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
